verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird has a dedicated Privacy and Data Protection practice with over 130 lawyers, 25 years' experience and former DPA members from the Irish DPC and CNIL. It backs this with a published GDPR compliance guide and a free SCC Generator Tool for EU data-transfer agreements, so the core privacy-counsel story is clearly documented. Missing for 10: evidence of non-EU regimes such as CCPA or India's DPDP Act, evidence of a cybersecurity practice, and independent or third-party corroboration.
